findings.issue: צרעת is a common noun (H6883 feminine absolute), not a proper name; tsaráat leaves the lemma untranslated.
Qal perfect הפך is smoothed as the pronominal se volvió; the hair still turns white, with no new participant.
Masculine עמוק follows the construct מראה הנגע and, with both nouns masculine, can predicate the appearance or the plague; profunda after plaga is readable as depth of the plague.

notes: Seeing, priest, plague, skin, flesh, hair, white, his flesh, הוא as él, and the two 3ms objects match the tokens.
